Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh were hapless on the field, with Mustafizur picking up 3 wickets. Mahmudullah brought himself on in the death and picked up 2 wickets. Can the batsmen take them home?
A fine batting display by Sri Lanka again. The 56-run stand for the opening wicket set it up and the two Kusals exploded. Tharanga played a lovely cameo towards the end to take the total past 200.

Upul Tharanga is having a chat with Sanjay Manjrekar. Says that when he went in to bat, two wickets were down but Kusal Perera had given a terrific start, so it was easy for him to go out and enjoy the game. On his different role in the middle order as compared to opening, Upul says that he has done it in ODIs but T20Is are a different format. Selflessly says that he will do whatever the team asks. States that Sri Lanka have been playing attacking cricket for the last decade or so. They have the players and the talent which is coming up beautifully. Feels that 214 is a good total but we have to bowl well/
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery. A direct hit by the fielder but the batsman makes it home. A dot to finish.
SIX! FEROCIOUS! A short ball on middle and leg, Mendis pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FREE HIT TIME! Does it matter at this stage? Every ball is a Free Hit.
NO BALL! That slipped out of the hand and Tharanga ducked in time. The keeper fumbled again and the batsmen ran a single.
Jeevan Mendis is the new man in.
OUT! Second wicket in the over. A length ball, on middle and leg, Thisara heaves but gets a top edge. Simple catch to Nazmul Islam at deep square leg.
A high full toss, on middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a run.
Thisara Perera is the new man in...

OUT! Kusal Perera falls in the final over. A length ball outside off, Perera looks to pull but is way too early into the shot. Gets a top edge which goes high in the air. Mushfiqur Rahim calls for it, hardly has to move but it is a swirler. Keeps his eyes on the ball and takes a good catch. End of a fine knock.
Another poor ball. Way down the leg side, Tharanga misses out on the pull, the keeper fumbles and concedes a bye. WIDE it is.
FOUR! A short ball on middle and leg, Tharanga gets across and helps it over short fine leg for a boundary! 50-run stand is up as well.
Poor start. Down the leg side, Tharanga gets across to paddle but misses.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl the final over. Can he keep the runs under 10?
Another full toss, driven through the covers for a single. 14 from the over, Rubel finishes 5 short of a half century.
Full toss on off, pushed towards long on for a brace.
FOUR! Fine shot. A length ball outside off, Tharanga chips this over cover and gets a boundary!
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a single.
Outside off, a swing and a miss.
SIX! Again, the first ball of an over goes for a six. Dropped short on middle, Perera rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie! The stand is worth 40 from 19 balls.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single. 4-0-31-0 for Mehidy, not a bad result, given the opposition score.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.

NOT OUT. Smart work from Rahim but Kusal escapes. Very full outside off, Perera looks to play the reverse sweep but misses. He loses his balance a touch but Rahim does not whip the bails off at that moment. He waits and waits and waits and sees Kusal's foot going in the air. Now he takes the bails off. He appeals for the stumping and it is referred upstairs. The third umpire takes a longggggg look at that and eventually decides that Perera has just got his foot back in.
Out or not out? Mushfiqur Rahim has effected a smart stumping here. It has been referred upstairs...
FOUR! Now the reverse sweep comes. Full and outside off, Kusal reverse sweeps it over point for consecutive boundaries!
FOUR! That is dropped short, stays low as well, Kusal pulls it through square leg for a boundary!
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Mehedi Hasan is back on.
Just a single. Down the leg side, helped away towards square leg. 17 from that over.
FOUR! Excellent batting. Fractionally short outside off, Tharanga goes back and cuts it past short third man for another boundary! 4,6,4! What is more?
SIX! CREAMED! Poor bowling continues, so does the pounding. A length ball on middle and leg, Tharanga helps it over square leg and clears the fence with ease!
FOUR! Nicely played. A short ball, down the leg side, fine leg is up, need anything more? Helped past short fine leg for a boundary. The stand moves to 13 from 9 balls.
A short ball now, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
On middle, heaved through mid-wicket for a single.
Rubel Hossain is back on.
Lucky! Full and outside off, Perera looks to play the reverse sweep but the bounce gets big on him, takes the glove and lobs over short third man. Two runs taken.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a quick run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, flicked through square leg for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Upul Tharanga is the new man in.

OUT! Chandimal departs now. A length ball outside off, Chandimal looks to flick but gets a leading edge. Sabbir Rahman keeps his eyes on the ball from mid off, runs to his left and takes a good diving catch.
Outside off, Chandimal looks to pull but misses.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers where it is brilliantly stopped.
Outside off, punched through the covers where Sabbir Rahman makes a brilliant diving stop to his left. Two runs taken.

Danushka Gunathilaka is giving an interview at the sidelines. He says that Sri Lanka are looking very confident now, after beating India. Reckons that positive cricket is the way to go in this age. Praises Kusal Perera, after coming back so well after injury. Hopes to get more than 200 tonight. On his upcoming birthday next Saturday, he wishes that Sri Lanka make it to the final and hand him a good birthday present.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
FOUR! The runs keep coming. A full ball outside off, Perera lofts this over the bowler and gets a boundary. Half century for Kusal Perera, a fine innings.
Punches this through the covers for a single. 8 runs and 2 wickets from that over - worthy gamble from the Bangladesh skipper.
Skipper Dinesh Chandimal walks in now, replacing Shanaka.

OUT! A quick wicket for Bangladesh. Stop the press again. A short ball, on middle and off, Shanaka looks to send this out of the ground but his pull shot barely has any strength. Straight to Sabbir Rahman at deep mid-wicket.

Full and outside off, Shanaka looks to play the paddle but misses. The ball goes off his pads to the off side and there is some confusion in the running, but eventually, the batsmen get back in. The keeper had quickly got to the ball to his right.
On middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Dasun Shanaka walks in at number 4, replacing Kusal Mendis.

OUT! Stop the press. Bangladesh have a wicket. Better delivery from the Bangladesh skipper. He slows this one outside off and bowls it a bit wider. Which means Mendis has to reach out to play the slog sweep. There is feeble connection and the ball lands safely in the hands of  Sabbir Rahman at deep mid-wicket. End of the 85-run stand.
SIX! CRASH! Welcome, captain. A short ball, fired outside off, Mendis goes back and heaves it over mid-wicket for a biggie!
Big gamble. Mahmudullah brings himself on.
A short ball, Kusal tries the heave but misses. 12 from that over, 49 off the last 4!
FOUR! More poor bowling. Down the leg side, short as well, pulled past short fine leg.
FOUR! CRACK! A short ball outside off, Kusal gives himself room to the leg side and slaps it over covers for a boundary!
A short ball on middle, Perera looks to pull but is beaten by pace.
WIDE. Another one well outside off, left alone.

Full and outside off, Mendis gets across his stumps and looks to paddle, only to miss. Sarkar appeals for LBW while the batsmen take a single in the meanwhile. Impact seemed to be outside off while replays seemed to indicate an inside edge. Leg bye given by the umpire though.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
WIDE. A slower ball gone awry, wide outside off, left alone.
Interesting. Desperate times. Soumya Sarkar to bowl now.
Comes down the track again, makes the ball into a full toss and pushes it down to long on for one.
Comes down the track and pulls it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Banged short, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
Outside off, punched through point for a single.
Outside off, pushed towards point for a quick single. Half century for Mendis, his third in T20Is, all against Bangladesh!
SIX! CLOUT! They know no fear. A short ball on middle, Mendis jumps down the track and pulls it over long on for a biggie!
The only wicket-taker so far is back on. Mustafizur Rahman to bowl now.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, pushed past the bowler towards long off for a single.
FOUR! More runs! Outside off, Kusal plays the reverse sweep and beats short third man! 50-STAND IS UP, in just 36 balls!
SIX! CLUNK! Tossed up on middle, Perera dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and sends it sailing over long on!
Darted in on middle, pushed down to long on for a single.
Outside off, Perera looks to play the reverse sweep but misses.
Short and outside off, cut through point for another brace.
Comes down the track and works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Pushes this through mid on for a run.
SIX! CLUBBED! Another big hit. Full and around middle and off, Mendis goes down and slog sweeps it massively over square leg!
Comes down the track and eases it to long off for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Full and down the leg side, paddled fine for a run.
On middle and leg, flicked away for a single.
Full and outside off, Kusal drives this uppishly but it does not carry to cover.
Full on middle, driven through mid on for another brace.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Full on middle, driven through mid on for a couple.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Nazmul Islam to bowl now.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Full on middle, driven straight back to the bowler.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, reverse swept straight to point.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Spin time. Mehidy Hasan Miraz is on now.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. 70/1 in the Powerplay.
FOUR! CLOBBERED! On middle and leg, Kusal backs away and swings it over mid-wicket for another boundary!
The batsman has attempted to put bat on ball - but fails.
FOUR! A length ball on middle, Perera blasts it over mid on and gets a boundary!
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Down the leg side, flicked towards short fine leg.
Change of ends for Rubel now.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Mendis chips it over mid off and gets a boundary!
Outside off, played straight to point.
WIDE. Another one down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Full on middle, pushed towards mid on for a quick single.
Kusal Perera walks in next.
OUT! The off stump takes a beating. The cutter from the Fizz, cuts into Gunathilaka who has a wild slog across the line, only to miss. Kaboom.
FOUR! Short and down the leg side, Gunathilaka pulls it past short fine leg for a boundary!
Outside off, a play and a miss.
The Fizz has a change of ends.
Full and outside off, driven wide of mid off for a single.
FIVE WIDES! Nightmare. Way down the leg side, Gunathilaka cannot get even a tickle, the keeper misses it too and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
WIDE. A short ball down the leg side. Danushka ducks.
A short ball outside off, Gunathilaka looks to pull but the ball goes off his shoulders to third man. A couple of leg byes taken.
Good length ball outside off, stabbed towards cover.
SIX! What an incredible hit that is! Good length delivery, angling away a bit, Danushka bends is back knee and murders his lofted shot over extra cover for the second maxmium of the over.
Stays back to a length ball and dabs it fine down to third man for a single.

SIX! What a shot! Taskin concedes back-to-back biggies! He was hit for one on the last ball of the first over and is welcomed with one now. Ahead of a length and angling in, Mendis whips it over long on for a maximum all the way.
Change of ends for Taskin Ahmed.

Good comeback from Rubel after getting hit for a boundary on the first ball! Ho! Ho! Ho! There is some words of wisdom being exchanged between the bowler and the batter. The umpire calms them down. Shortish delivery on middle, pulled behind square on the leg side for a single.
Flicks it through mid-wicket and scampers through for one.
Backs away to a back of a length delivery and mistimes the punch towards mid off.
Short of a length delivery on middle and leg, Gunathilaka gets cramped for room as he looks to tap and run but wears it on the gloves.
Shortish and slanting away outside off, Danushka looks to cut but there is extra bounce and good pace which doesn't let him free his arms.

FOUR! Shot! Gunathilaka welcome Rubel in some style. Gets a length delivery near the pads and he drops kicks it over deep backward square leg. Mehidy Hasan in the deep runs behind and tries to catch it but the ball was far away from his reach.
Early change then. Rubel Hossain is brought into the attack.
Hits the deck hard, served it outside off, Gunathilaka slaps it over point and will keep strike. 24 from the first two overs.
FOUR! Boom! Rahman drops it on a back of a length outside off, Gunathilaka stays put and muscles it with a flat-bat over the mid off fielder for a boundary. Good start for Sri Lanka again.
Another one one a similar length, Kusal just opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for an easy single.
Short and angling away wider on off, Mendis steers it behind point and picks up a brace.
Back of a length delivery on middle, climbing off the deck, DG hops back and taps it towards square leg for a brisk single. Running has been good from this pair.
Rahman from over the wicket, hurls it on a back of a length outside off, Danushka clips it in front of square on the leg side. Calls for two immediately and gets it comfortably in the end.
Mustafizur Rahman to bowl from the other end.

SIX! Top edge but doesn't matter! Short ball, angling in on the body of the batsman. Mendis walks across and goes for the pull. Gets a top edge but it flies well over fine leg for the first half a dozen of the match. 13 off the first over.

Chance of a run out! Good length ball outside off, Gunathilaka taps it towards the off side and sets off. The man at from covers charges to the ball and underarms a throw at the bowler's end but misses his target. The ball rolls towards mid-wicket but Sri Lanka are happy with one.
Pitches it up on off, Danushka leans ahead and drives it straight to the man at mid off.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven towards mid off where the fielder stops it with a dive. A single taken.

FOUR! Inside edge and though! Lucky, Kusal! Taskin angles in a length delivery on middle, it skids a bit off the deck as Mendis looks to defend but gets a thick inside edge which evades the leg pole and races down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.

Sri Lanka are away! On a length and just around middle and leg, Gunathilaka tucks it towards mid-wicket. The fielder scores a direct hit at the bowler's end but no harm done as the batsman was comfortably in.

We are all set for the action to kickoff. The players and umpires make their way out to the middle. The two Lankan openers are Danushka Gunathilaka and Kusal Mendis. It will be Taskin Ahmed to start off with the bowling proceedings. A wide slip in place. Let's play, says the umpire...

Sri Lanka skipper, Dinesh Chandimal starts by saying they are really pumped up with the win over India. Adds they would have batted first anyway as they are looking to rack up a big total and put Bangladesh under pressure. Reckons they have certain plans against certain teams and is happy to have executed it to perfection which has helped them gain success since the start of the year. Informs even they are unchanged from their last game.

Bangladesh skipper, Mahmudullah feels the wicket looks good with a bit of grass on it. Hopes to restrict Sri Lanka to a total that they can chase down later. States with the rain around, they have decided to bowl first. Feels they didn't do that bad against India in the previous game and hopes for a good show tonight. Informs they are going in with the same team.

TOSS - After a 10-minute delay we are all set for the toss to happen. Murali Kartik is alongside the two skippers. Chandimal flips the coin and it comes down in favour of Mahmudullah. Bangladesh opt to bowl!

Before anything else, let me tell you the conditions are not looking good in Colombo as the covers were on a while back due to the rain. But the good news is that they have been peeled off and we won't be having a scheduled toss. Let's hope it clears out soon and we get a full-fledged game. Stay with us as we will keep you posted as and when we get an update.

Bangladesh, well they are having a tough time in this format. After losing the series at home against the hosts recently, they suffered a hammering at the hands of the Indians in their first game. They need something special tonight if they are to come out victorious. Will they be able to turn things around? Only time will tell.

Hello and welcome for the third game of the tri-series. It's Sri Lanka taking on Bangladesh at the R. Premdasa Stadium, Colombo. The hosts shocked the world by beating India in the opening encounter and by doing so, they head into this game as favorites. Riding on Kusal Perera's blazing fifty, they toppled the Indians to pull off a great win and start the series on a right note.
